snippet.title: Heartbeat Seen After IVF: How Many Pregnancies Continue? #Shorts
snippet.description:
Heartbeat seen after IVF: how many pregnancies continue? Out of ten IVF pregnancies where the heartbeat was seen, how many keep going? Dr Senai Aksoy shares statistical benchmarks from studies, by age: these describe groups, not your individual situation.

Study shown: Spandorfer, Fertil Steril 2004

▶ Full video: https://youtu.be/queLygimeS8

#IVF #FirstUltrasound #Fertility

For more information:
WhatsApp: +90 507 380 28 05
Website: https://www.draksoyivf.com

MEDICAL INFORMATION
This video is for education and information only. It is not personal medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation. Your individual circumstances require assessment by a qualified clinician.

LANGUAGE AND PRODUCTION
This is an English-dubbed excerpt of Dr Aksoy's original French educational video, using an AI voice based on Dr Aksoy's own voice. Lip movements were not altered.
